summary: Reads a fresh performance-counter timestamp via QPCTimestampReadWrapper, subtracts two stored 64-bit counter pairs (this+0x18/0x1C and this+0x28/0x2C), and converts the 64-bit difference into a scaled double: the low dword divided by a divisor derived from the integer at this+0x0, plus the high dword scaled by the double at this+0x8, plus the double at this+0x10. Twin of HighPrecisionTimerCounterArithmetic (005565b0) per the packet prelabel.

operations.description: Snapshot the two stored 64-bit counter pairs from this+0x18/0x1C (low/high) and this+0x28/0x2C before sampling the timestamp.
Call QPCTimestampReadWrapper(this, high_ptr, low_ptr) to capture the current performance-counter timestamp into v7.
Subtract both stored counter pairs from the fresh sample: v7 = v7 - pair(0x18,0x1C) - pair(0x28,0x2C).
Read the integer at this+0x0 to seed the divisor used in the result conversion.
Scale the difference into a double: (double)(unsigned int)v7 / divisor + (double)(unsigned int)(v7 >> 32) * this[1] + this[2], using the scale double at this+0x8 and the offset double at this+0x10.
